name: Badge
description: A small, non-interactive label for a status, category or count. The text is always there; a dot or an icon can lead it.

livewire.name: badge
capabilities: The 2.x value attribute still renders as the label, deprecated: use the slot

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment. ghost drops the fill and padding, for a dot and a word in running text. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color. Use the same color for the same status everywhere. Emitted as data-color.
props.a11y: Color is never the only signal: the label says the status.

props.name: dot
props.description: A small decorative dot before the label, in the badge's color.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon name before the label, resolved through the icon registry. Arrows mirror in RTL. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { label: '…' }.

requirements: Not interactive: a badge is never a button or a link. Use a Button or a filter chip for that.
The label is always present; the dot and the icon are aria-hidden.
Soft and solid badges keep 4.5:1 text on their fill in every theme; outline and ghost on the surface.
In high contrast, soft badges gain an edge in the tone's border color.
In forced colors the badge keeps an edge and the dot uses CanvasText.
